supplementalCliCommands.invocation: npm run lint:report -- --policy PATH --policy-project ID --output PATH [options]
supplementalCliCommands.behavior: Every listed option takes one following nonempty value that must not start with --. Repeated scalar options use the last value; repeated list options append. Unknown options and missing required values fail with exit 2. --help returns help before required checks; --include-debt and --include-experimental are no-value booleans documented in Defined Flags. Runtime failure or failed tools use exit 1; blocking findings use exit 3; a successful unblocked report uses exit 0. Kubernetes overrides are passed only when at least one raw-manifest or helm-chart entry exists.

options.name: --policy
options.meaning: Lint policy file, resolved against the invoking current directory.

options.name: --policy-project
options.meaning: Project ID selected within the lint policy.

options.name: --output
options.meaning: Validated JSON report destination, atomically replaced; parent directories are created.

options.name: --working-directory
options.meaning: Repository to inspect; resolved to an absolute path.

options.name: --project
options.meaning: Project name recorded in the report.

options.name: --module-path
options.meaning: Restrict tools to one repository-relative module.

options.name: --tier
options.meaning: Select lint tier; any other value is rejected.

options.name: --changed-file
options.meaning: Append a changed file restriction in argument order.

options.name: --raw-manifest
options.meaning: Append a Kubernetes raw input override.

options.name: --helm-chart
options.meaning: Append a Kubernetes chart input override.

supplementalCliCommands.behavior: Requires a full 40-character lowercase hex revision. The revision value uses equals syntax, not a separate following argument. The first --revision= occurrence wins. Without --write, compare generated bytes with the current reader reference; --write replaces it. Other command-line tokens are not used as option definitions by these parsers.

options.name: --revision=SHA
options.default: Existing buster-error-codes.md Evidence revision; no fallback when absent.
options.meaning: Select source citation revision for the generated reference.

supplementalCliCommands.behavior: Requires a full 40-character lowercase hex revision identifying an existing commit; pinned inputs must match current inputs. The revision value uses equals syntax, not a separate following argument. The first --revision= occurrence wins. Without --write, compare generated bytes with the current reader reference; --write replaces it. Other command-line tokens are not used as option definitions by these parsers.

options.name: --revision=SHA
options.default: Existing provider reference Evidence revision, then 3cf7dc4f72c2ae1e0ba4c47cceb08c98f4c70b7f.
options.meaning: Select source citation revision for the generated reference.
